verdict.rationale: The security docs give a documented privacy-deletion workflow: scope each end-user or tenant to a container tag, then delete that container's content via the API or console when the user requests deletion. Document operations also support deleting individual ingested documents. Together these cover per-entity and per-user erasure plus item-level deletion of documents. Missing for 10: an explicit endpoint for deleting a single extracted memory (as opposed to a document), confirmation that derived profiles and graph facts are purged on erasure, a documented account-wide full-erasure operation, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
